name: Chives
siboNotes: Chives are the go-to onion substitute on a low-FODMAP diet. One tablespoon adds excellent onion-like flavor without triggering symptoms. Unlike onions and garlic, chives are safe and don't contain problematic fructans.
preparationTips: Add at end of cooking to preserve flavor
Great as garnish for eggs, potatoes, soups
Can be used more generously than scallion greens
